Anthropic introduced Claude Opus 5.5 on September 22, reporting a 200,000-line codebase audit in under three hours and a HAProxy C-to-Rust rewrite completed in 9.5 hours at 51% lower cost than Fable 5.1.

Anthropic says Opus 5.5 is now available on all platforms, raises five-hour limits on Pro, Max, and Team plans, and lets subscribers save a rate-limit reset, but the announcement gives no reset time and notes that its benchmarks used production safeguards and adaptive max-effort settings.
